resources.string: VisionNav needs your precise location to give walking directions and tell you where you are.
VisionNav needs the camera to describe what is in front of you. Images stay on your phone.
VisionNav needs the microphone so you can give voice commands. Speech is only captured while you are giving a command.
VisionNav uses your step activity to know whether you are walking or standing still.
VisionNav needs permission to send text messages so it can text your location to your emergency contacts after you confirm an SOS.
VisionNav shows a notification while guidance is running, so you can stop it at any time.
